function.name: _company_expert_team_save
function.description: Create or partially update a team expert team. Omit expertTeam.id when creating; when updating, pass an existing expertTeam.id and include only fields that should change. Omitted fields are preserved. Returns the expert team ID. Do not use _company_expert_save because it only creates ordinary experts.

expertTeam.description: Expert team base configuration. For create, pass name. For update, pass id and only fields that should change. companyId/createAccountId/updateAccountId/createTime/updateTime are set by the backend; do not pass them.

id.description: Expert team ID. Omit for create; pass an existing expert team ID for update.

name.description: Expert team name, required, up to 128 characters.

avatar.description: Avatar URL or Element UI icon class. Optional.

description.description: Expert team responsibility description, including goal, scope, collaboration model, stage outputs, and limits.

status.description: Expert team status. Use draft by default; use enabled only when explicitly requested.

leadMemberId.description: Team lead member ID. For a new team, omit this unless memberList contains an explicit stable id for the referenced member.

aiModelKey.description: AI model key. You may call _company_get_ai_model_list first. Optional.

confirmBeforePersist.description: Whether to confirm before persistence. Default true.

configJson.description: Extension configuration JSON string. Optional; omit unless clearly needed.

memberList.description: Expert team members. When updating, omit this field to preserve all members, pass an empty array to clear them, or pass an array to replace the list. A replacement array must include every member that should remain; omitted members are deleted. For retained members, use IDs returned by _company_expert_team_get and include only fields that should change. Provide at least one member when creating a team.

id.description: Member ID. Optional for new members; required if referenced by expertTeam.leadMemberId or stageList.leadMemberId.

aiModelKey.description: AI model key for this member. Optional.

stageCodes.description: JSON string of stage codes this member participates in, for example ["analysis","review"].

skillListJson.description: JSON string of skills available to this member. Use only real skills; do not fabricate skill IDs.

canBeLead.description: Whether this member can be the team lead. At least one member should usually be true.

stageList.description: Expert team stages. When updating, omit this field to preserve all stages, pass an empty array to clear them, or pass an array to replace the list. A replacement array must include every stage that should remain; omitted stages are deleted. For retained stages, use IDs returned by _company_expert_team_get and include only fields that should change. Provide at least one stage when creating a team.

id.description: Stage ID. Optional for new stages.

code.description: Stage code, required, for example analysis, design, execution, or review.

description.description: Stage goal, input, processing approach, and output.

leadMemberId.description: Stage lead member ID. Must exist in memberList or existing members; omit for new teams unless member IDs are explicit.

requiredInputJson.description: Stage required input JSON string. Optional.

outputSchemaJson.description: Stage output schema JSON string. Optional.

preStageCodes.description: JSON string of prerequisite stage codes, for example ["analysis"].
